description: Full persona x persona matchup matrix at competent skill, seat-swapped, on the standard map. Every distinct-persona cross pairing is covered exactly once as an unordered pair (so e.g. objective-rusher vs defender, aggressor vs defender, merchant vs aggressor, and naval-strategist vs expansionist are all included as a subset of the full 8-choose-2 matrix); same-persona mirrors are not auto-generated (see docs/SIMULATION.md) and are covered separately by explorer-coverage.json and the dedicated unit tests for matchup-matrix mirror handling.
